name: Improved Reading Algorithm with Pre-processing
aliases: Algorithm for Improved Reading of Volume Datasets from Storage
definition: An extension of the base rearrangement algorithm that includes pre-processing steps (P1 and P2) to segment voxels into foreground/background and surface/interior categories before assigning priorities, enabling immediate visualization of the surface (S0).
summary: This algorithm segments voxels into foreground and background categories before assigning priorities, enabling immediate surface visualization while less important data loads in the background.
